name: React Wheel Picker
summary: iOS-like wheel picker components for React with inertia scrolling, infinite loop and keyboard type-ahead.
description: Two unstyled React components, WheelPickerWrapper and WheelPicker, that render a wheel of options with natural touch scrolling, mouse drag and scroll on desktop, infinite loop scrolling and full keyboard navigation with type-ahead search. Install them from the ncdai shadcn registry with the shadcn CLI; the site ships demo setups for Vite, Next.js, Astro, Laravel, React Router, TanStack Start, TanStack Router and Gatsby.
